spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact spec surface: [Exposed=Window, SecureContext, IsolatedContext] binding via 'subApps' in window (verified against both the WICG IDL and Chromium's sub_apps.idl on main), the sub-apps permission policy token, the isolated-app:// scheme requirement, and a live window.subApps.list() call — with a navigator.subApps read included only to show the spec binds to Window, not Navigator.

interactive.rationale: One real control drives the whole probe: the button populates a five-row PASS/FAIL table with measured values and a verdict naming the exact blocking prerequisite; nothing is precomputed or faked.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises a five-part probe naming the blocking prerequisite; the page delivers exactly that, framed around Chrome 152's enabled-by-default status (runtime feature SubApps is 'stable' in runtime_enabled_features.json5, fetched 2026-08-16).

edge_cases.rationale: Every negative branch renders honestly on an ordinary origin: scheme FAIL with the actual location.protocol, unbound interface, unrecognised policy token (guarded so no console warning fires), and no-live-call-attempted — the verdict explicitly says no Chrome flag would change the result.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6260680824061952, the WICG spec, the official sample README, and the feature overview.

conformance.rationale: The new v152 feature suite (9 assertions) covers the binding, the three method types, the SecureContext gate, the Window-not-Navigator contract, list()'s record shape, add()'s TypeError path validation, and a manual user-consent contract; executed live on the served page it reports the honest 2 pass / 6 fail / 1 blocked for a non-IWA origin.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome via the repo CDP harness (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this cloud environment): probe clicked, all 5 rows and verdict text asserted ('1 of 5 gates passed', scheme blocker named), button keyboard-focusable, zero console errors/warnings and zero network failures; post-interaction full-page screenshot captured and read (scratchpad/gate-after.png), plus deno task responsive-check screenshots for the feature (reports/responsive/v152/sub-apps-for-iwas/).

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts subapps-gate-available on the real success branch and subapps-gate-unavailable on the honest fallback, with secure/isolatedScheme/bound/liveOk detail and no noisy console paths.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only, button sets background and color together with a 44px min height and focus-visible outline, PASS/FAIL colours (accent-emerald/accent-rose) sit on near-white backgrounds, table uses fixed layout + overflow-wrap so long detail strings never overflow.

accessibility.rationale: Semantic table with caption and th scope, verdict in role=status aria-live=polite so the outcome is announced, single keyboard-operable button with visible focus, and probe detail exposed as text rather than colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check v152/sub-apps-for-iwas: desktop OK (clean) and mobile OK; concept measured directly post-interaction at 360×740 DPR3: scrollWidth=360, no clipped controls; desktop verified at 1280 with the same interaction script.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the probe inside a real installed IWA when a ChromeOS 152 environment is available
openQuestions.detail: All five gates were exercised on their honest negative branches (ordinary http/https origin). The positive branch — all gates PASS and list() resolving — is implemented but has only been reasoned from the spec and Chromium IDL, not executed, because no isolated-app:// context exists in this environment. A ChromeOS device or IWA dev-mode install should confirm the success verdict copy renders correctly.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status updates after button activation dynamic results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce dynamic results through role=status/aria-live regions tied to the activating control; use semantic tables with caption and scoped headers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdict paragraph is role=status aria-live=polite and updates on the same activation as the table; the gate table keeps caption + th scope from the v150 predecessor.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP interaction run 2026-08-16: verdict textContent asserted after click; zero console errors.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table long identifiers narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give tables a deterministic track layout and let long unbreakable tokens wrap with overflow-wrap.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: table-layout:fixed with a narrow status column plus overflow-wrap:anywhere on cells, carried over from the v150 fix that resolved the same table's 466px overflow.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Post-interaction mobile measurement 2026-08-16: scrollWidth=360 at 360px viewport.

summary: Adaptation of the browser-verified v150 capability gate for the Chrome 152 enabled-by-default milestone: adds an isolated-app:// scheme row and a Window-vs-Navigator binding read, reframes all copy from developer-trial flags to the stable runtime feature, and keeps the four original gates. All controls and negative branches exercised via the repo's headless-Chrome CDP harness with zero console errors; mobile and desktop matrix pass.
